faqs.question: What does 240 GSM combed cotton mean?
faqs.answer: GSM stands for grams per square meter. Standard market tees range from 160-180 GSM, which can feel thin and limp. TORI WEAR uses custom 240 GSM heavy combed cotton: it creates a structured boxy silhouette, drapes without clinging to the body, and endures dozens of washes without warping.

faqs.question: Are TORI WEAR designs officially licensed or original?
faqs.answer: All TORI WEAR artwork, character profiles, typography, and lore pillars are 100% original creations designed by our in-house Tokyo-inspired atelier. We do not use pirated screenshots or generic AI clipart.

faqs.question: How fast is delivery across India?
faqs.answer: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours from our fulfillment hub. Metro cities (Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai) receive orders in 2-3 business days. Rest of India typically arrives in 4-6 business days with live tracking via BlueDart and Delhivery.

faqs.question: Can I return or exchange for a different size?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer a hassle-free 7-day doorstep return and exchange policy. You can initiate a size exchange or return directly from your Order History tab with photo verification. Our reverse courier picks it up straight from your address.

faqs.question: Is Cash on Delivery (COD) available?
faqs.answer: Yes, Cash on Delivery is available across 19,000+ PIN codes in India. You can also pay seamlessly via UPI, credit/debit cards, and net banking with instant confirmation.
